prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Mina Castellan after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: A/B test readouts
client: Hearthstone Games
client_industry: gaming
start: 2022-08
end: 2022-10
engagement: hourly
stack:
- SQL
- Python
- statsmodels
implied_skills:
- experiment design
built: A repeatable readout template for in-app store experiments with power checks
  before launch.
metrics:
- 11 experiments analysed
- 2 underpowered tests stopped early

The review is from: Hearthstone Games
Rating: 4.0 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- Focus mostly on communication; do not just repeat the project summary.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "experiment design".
text: Mina was solid to work with on our A/B test readouts and kept things moving without a lot of back-and-forth. Communication was generally clear and she was responsive when we needed updates, which helped us stay on track across the engagement. She analyzed 11 experiments and flagged 2 underpowered tests early, which was useful. My only complaint is that communication could occasionally be a bit more proactive when timelines shifted.
